rules.description: Cmd+A -> Cmd+Ctrl+A (free Cmd+A for custom Mac shortcut, e.g. Spotlight)
Shift+Home -> select to beginning of line
Shift+End -> select to end of line
Ctrl+Shift+Home -> select to top of document
Ctrl+Shift+End -> select to end of document
PC Ctrl shortcuts: A/X/Z/S/F/N/T/W/R/Y/O/P/Q -> Cmd equivalents
